title: Continuity of the extended Gaussian isoperimetric profile
statement: Extend the function $\alpha\mapsto\varphi(q(\alpha))$ continuously to $[0,1]$, where $\varphi$ is the standard Gaussian density and $q(\alpha)$ is the unique real number whose standard Gaussian upper tail is $\alpha$ for $0<\alpha<1$; set the endpoint values to $0$. This extended function is continuous on $[0,1]$.
hypotheses_covered: the domain is the closed interval $[0,1]$
caveat: The formal statement names a specific extension construction; the prose describes its intended continuous extension and endpoint values.
